title: Have I Been Pwned skill roadmap

beginner.title: Get started with Have I Been Pwned
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Have I Been Pwned, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set it up right
beginner.outcome: You can: install and configure Have I Been Pwned
beginner.practice: Set up Have I Been Pwned and store recovery details safely

beginner.title: Everyday use
beginner.outcome: You can: use Have I Been Pwned without friction
beginner.practice: Use Have I Been Pwned for a week on your main accounts

intermediate.title: Protect what matters most
intermediate.outcome: You can: secure your critical accounts

intermediate.title: Spot scams
intermediate.outcome: You can: recognise phishing and fraud

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Have I Been Pwned
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Have I Been Pwned distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Have I Been Pwned
expert.outcome: You can: use Have I Been Pwned's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Help family or team
expert.outcome: You can: roll out good security habits to others
expert.practice: Help two people set up Have I Been Pwned

expert.title: Integrate Have I Been Pwned into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Have I Been Pwned with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Have I Been Pwned to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Have I Been Pwned well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Have I Been Pwned" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
